'''Decipher (Reflections III foil)''' — [[Sebulba's Podracer (Reflections III Foil)|Sebulba's Podracer (foil)]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Podracer: Sebulba's Podracer, Tatooine, R |strategy=By Eric Olsonhttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/sebulbaspodracer.html If you're a Dark side player, and you want to win a podrace, then this is your best choice. He adds 3 to each of his race destinies, so depending on the destiny in your deck, he will usually finish the race for you in 4 turns. To make it even more likely he'll win, he also gets a head start. Since he can prevent the opponent from drawing racing destiny if he's tied, you will always get a head start at the beginning of the race when both racing totals are zero. If your opponent manages to catch up to you, there's no worries, because you can stop the opponent from drawing destiny every time you're tied. This podracer is full of dirty tricks! |has_refs=1 }}

'''Decipher (Reflections III foil)''' — [[Anakin's Podracer (Reflections III Foil)|Anakin's Podracer (foil)]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Podracer: Anakin's Podracer, Tatooine, R |strategy=By I-Ming Chenhttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/anakinspodracer.html Like the Indianapolis 500? Have a "Need For Speed?" Fond of racing like in Initial D? Did you enjoy the Podrace scene the best in The [[Phantom]] Menance? The characteristics of this famous podracer is well represented in the game text. It maybe not be the fastest of all the podracers, but it is incredibly good at catching up (i.e. getting to choose two racing destinies) when you are losing the podrace -- which is almost always the case since the [[Sebulba]] has a few tricks to get a good start! Being able to pick and choose your destiny is very handy especially at the beginning of the game since you have not had the opportunity to setup your destiny draws yet. The last aspect of [[Anakin's Podracer]] is that you can take the [[I Did It!]] epic event into hand. So instead of a 12 card swing from the Boonta Eve Podracing epic event, you get a 16 Force swing instead. And since you've done it and are headed to Disneyland, you will also get additional bonuses from [[I Did It!]] which last the remainder of the game. |rulings=* When drawing 2 race destiny, Light decides to stack after each draw, and may stack both.[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Anakin%27s%20Podracer Scomp Link Access: Anakin's Podracer], scomp.starwarsccg.org.
